submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for the structural token of a code statement or used expression: it peaks on the operator (=, +, -, ==, &&), delimiter (comma, colon, parens/brackets, =>) or expression keyword (return, for, in) that carries the syntax, including = inside comments and operators in formulas even when prose-embedded or merely mentioned (weakly). It stays weak on word-form operators (plus), on prose/markup/bare-list commas and colons, on spaced or singleton parens/brackets and merely mentioned operators, and quiet on operand names, numbers and string contents.
rival_explanations: It is a generic code-context detector that fires on any frequent code token including operands, numbers and identifiers, not specifically structural tokens.
It is a narrow = and return detector that does not fire on for/in, ==, &&, commas, colons, parens or +/- operators.
